description: Machine-readable compatibility contract for this Workspace Bundle. Downstream projects hatched via `npm run project:create` and external agents (Claude Code / Cursor / Command Code / DSH / hermes) bind to what is declared here. Verified by scripts/check-compat-manifest.cjs in `npm run check`.

framework.name: ruoyi-all-next
framework.note: templateVersion tracks the TEMPLATE, not the hatched project. package.json version is the project's own and is deliberately not compared.

evolution.note: Gates produce evidence on every `npm run check`; the backlog aggregates that evidence into prioritised work for an external agent. No agent loop runs in this repository.

frozen: messaging header keys (x-contract-version / x-trace-id / x-tenant-id / x-actor-id / x-idempotency-key / x-source-domain)
cross-domain integration via Domain Facade only
tenant isolation via getCurrentTenantId() plus the 8 base audit columns
additive: new domains (append to catalog layers and domains)
new actions and new permission codes
new gates wired into npm run check
breaking: changing an existing action payload or error contract
changing or removing an RPC subject or messaging header key
breakingProcedure: regenerate contracts: npm run domain:contracts && npm run domain:manifests && npm run domain:seams
record the change in docs/features/sprint-prod/ and re-run npm run check
